children: Zentek reported unaudited Q2 fiscal 2027 net income of $17.2M, including a $19.7M non-cash Albany Graphite impairment reversal; excluding the reversal, the quarterly loss was $2.5M, about the same as a year earlier. Cash was $13.6M at September 30, 2026, versus $1.3M at March 31, 2026.
The non-cash reversal exceeded reported income; underlying quarterly loss was $2.5M, about the same as a year earlier.
The stronger cash position increases funding capacity; the release attributes it to May financing proceeds of approximately $16M net.
The move from a deficit to positive working capital signals improved near-term liquidity.
Cash use increased from the prior-year period, relevant to how long the balance can fund operations and projects.
The increase reflects the impairment reversal, not cash proceeds or a reported project sale.

This quarter combines improved liquidity with an accounting-driven profit, while the underlying quarterly loss was about the same as a year earlier. Further catalysts include reported ZenGUARD orders, scaled purification results, and independent testing of newer materials.
